name: route-rule-rule-to-empty-jump-to-accept
description: rule-to-empty with a jump to a chain that already accepts
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add rule inet f out jump sub
